task.name: hidden.summarize
task.description: Hidden layer summarization — generates structured summaries of ingested code elements

metadata.author: reh3376
metadata.notes: Shares system prompt with summarize.generate. Uses the same summarize service internally. Think mode benefits comprehension of complex code structures.

output_schema.description: Bare prose cluster summary (under 50 words). Production (internal/hidden/cluster_summarizer.go::Summarize) emits plain text — 'Output ONLY the summary text, no JSON' — not an object. REWARD-CORRECTNESS-002: was wrongly declared object, which mis-flagged 72 valid summaries as invalid-JSON.

quality_metrics.name: coverage
quality_metrics.description: Summary covers key aspects of the code element
